services.name: Shallow Water Grouper Fishing
services.desc: Come experience the world renowned Gag Grouper Fishery that Crystal River has to offer! Duration 6 Hours About 10 to 30 miles offshore. Our 2025 Gag Grouper Season runs from September 1st to September 14th. Catch and Release Trips are available most of the offseason. services.name: Scalloping
services.desc: Florida’s Nature Coast is an inshore fishing paradise. Duration Four Hour Charter About A private scallop charter in Crystal River, Florida is the perfect activity for a group of friends looking to relax, connect and enjoy some quality time in the beauty of the Nature Coast. With its picturesque shoreline, clear emerald-green waters, and a laid-back tropical atmosphere, this special river makes for an unforgettable experience. While everyone else heads to a crowded pool, you can find yourself in a different kind of water setting, complete with emerald green waters and gorgeous scenery. We’re willing to bet that your friends and family won’t let you go without them! Whats Provided Ice Adult
